endorsements.name: Sylvain Maret
endorsements.label: 4G/LTE Security : l'état de l'art
endorsements.description: This talk will focus on the security within 4G/LTE systems. It will gives an overview about the 4G/LTE architecture, the 3gpp standards and the security controls (best practices) in place in many 4G/LTE Operators and NVNO's. Based on this "classical" architecture the talk will present a threat modelling approach defining threat scenarios and vulnerabilities in a 4G/LTE usage in critical situation (Firstnet approach). Finally some defence architecture will be presented to mitigate risks in a critical network infrastructure.
endorsements.subtitle: Insomni'hack 2016
